summary: ibm.spectrum_virtualize was renamed to ibm.storage_virtualize. Both ship for now, and the old one is removed in Ansible 12.
questions: Do I need to change ibm.spectrum_virtualize FQCNs before Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: Update ibm.spectrum_virtualize FQCNs
answer_card.answer_md: Switch FQCNs from `ibm.spectrum_virtualize.*` to `ibm.storage_virtualize.*`. The old collection is removed in Ansible 12.
